note: Fresh nationwide Page Profit Check nightly batch. Ten public small-business opportunities only; one isolated worker per opportunity; no outreach is sent.

items.name: Ninja Window Washing, LLC
items.summary: Family-owned window washing site has clear services and phones, but the first screen and quote path can be tightened with stronger service-area trust and buyer paths.
items.angle: preserve the simple Wix/logo/photo style while clarifying residential, commercial, and gutter paths plus a stronger free-estimate next step.

items.name: Garcia Installation and Carpentry LLC
items.summary: Carpentry site has real service lists/photos and free-estimate contact info, but the homepage reads thin and can organize door/trim work into clearer project paths.
items.angle: keep the straightforward construction-template look while improving hero clarity, trust cues, service groupings, and what happens after requesting an estimate.

items.name: BZP Handyman Service LLC
items.summary: Handyman site has a useful service list and visible phone/email, but a giant undifferentiated list makes it hard for buyers to choose a next step.
items.angle: preserve the honest/fair/reliable handyman feel while turning the service list into scan-friendly repair paths and a specific quote CTA.

items.name: AirAid Heating & Cooling LLC
items.summary: HVAC site has strong trust cues like licensed/bonded/insured, ROC number, warranty, and discounts, but the page is cluttered and CTA hierarchy is weak.
items.angle: keep the bilingual, local HVAC contractor feel while surfacing license/warranty proof, service categories, and a call/text/email estimate flow.

items.name: Pristine Power Clean LLC
items.summary: Pressure-washing site exposes real address/email/phone but still includes obvious Wix template service names and a fake testimonial block.
items.angle: preserve the blue/white exterior-cleaning template while replacing template residue with real wash packages, proof, and a free-estimate path.

items.name: Kirgan's Property Solutions, LLC
items.summary: Weekend family property-solutions site lists valuable heavy-equipment services, but the homepage needs stronger hierarchy, service grouping, and estimate clarity.
items.angle: keep the hobby/family-owned rural equipment feel while organizing tree, excavation, cleanup, and hauling work into clearer buyer tasks.

items.name: JPDS General Contractors, LLC
items.summary: General contractor site has long-term experience and project categories, but the first screen is generic and the quote path/service hierarchy can be sharper.
items.angle: preserve the remodeler portfolio feel while making free estimates, core project categories, experience, and consultation next steps more visible.

items.name: Simon Professional Services LLC
items.summary: Home-improvement site has a real logo, address, email, phone, and service list, but much of the copy remains generic and the free-estimate action is buried.
items.angle: keep the simple contractor/template style while bringing the logo, service mix, location trust, and free-estimate CTA into a cleaner first screen.

items.name: Patriot Pros GA, LLC
items.location: Chatham, Effingham, Bryan & Liberty Counties, GA
items.summary: Pressure-washing site has a strong veteran/law-enforcement story and county service area, but the offer path can clarify packages and next steps sooner.
items.angle: preserve the patriotic/service-oriented look while tightening hero copy, residential/commercial paths, licensed-insured proof, and quote CTA hierarchy.

items.name: Viva Landscaping LLC
items.summary: Landscaping site has authentic project photos, licensing proof, and a broad service list, but the homepage needs clearer service paths and quote expectations.
items.angle: preserve the photo-led green landscape feel while organizing outdoor living, maintenance, irrigation/drainage, and pressure-washing paths around a free estimate.
